2608.21924.title: Modeling Claim Dependency Structure for Patent Litigation Prediction with Graph Attention Networks
2608.21924.paper_summary: Patent litigation imposes substantial costs on firms and distorts R&D incentives, making early risk identification a practically important task. While prior work has applied BERT-based models to patent claim text, two fundamental limitations remain: flat sequence encoding loses the dependency structure between independent and dependent claims that legally determines patent scope, and feeding the entire claim set to a single encoder discards legally critical text. A six-model ablation on 1.34 million USPTO utility patents confirms that per-claim encoding, graph connectivity, attention, and Attentional Aggregation each provide independent, additive predictive value. We propose ClaimGAT, a Graph Attention Network that encodes each claim independently, constructs a directed claim dependency graph, processes it with GATConv layers, and aggregates independent claims via Attentional Aggregation to yield both a litigation risk score and claim-level gate weights that enable post-hoc structural analysis. ClaimGAT achieves an AUC-ROC of 0.818 and a lift of 4.89x at the top 10%, using only information observable at the time of patent grant. It reveals a tendency in high-risk patents for structural selection and content sensitivity to diverge, a pattern consistent with defensive claim drafting.
2608.21924.paper_summary_zh: 專利訴訟對企業造成了巨大的成本，並扭曲了研發激勵，使早期風險識別成為一項實際重要的任務。雖然先前的研究已將基於BERT的模型應用於專利請求文本，但仍然存在兩個基本限制：平坦的序列編碼失去了獨立請求和依賴請求之間的依賴結構，這在法律上決定了專利範圍，而將整個請求集餵給單一編碼器則丟棄了法律上關鍵的文本。對134萬件美國專利商標局的實用專利進行的六模型消融實驗確認，每個請求的編碼、圖形連接性、注意力和注意力聚合各自提供獨立的、附加的預測價值。我們提出了ClaimGAT，一種圖形注意力網絡，獨立編碼每個請求，構建有向請求依賴圖，通過GATConv層進行處理，並通過注意力聚合來聚合獨立請求，以產生訴訟風險分數和允許事後結構分析的請求級別門權重。ClaimGAT在僅使用專利授予時可觀察到的信息的情況下，實現了0.818的AUC-ROC和在前10%中4.89倍的提升。它揭示了高風險專利在結構選擇和內容敏感性上出現分歧的趨勢，這一模式與防禦性請求撰寫一致。
2608.21924.author: Takao Arai et.al.
